THIRD PASS — still unresolved (no defensible lon/lat for either endpoint), but with an incremental narrowing beyond pass 2's 'North Sinai Governorate' fix. WebSearch worked from the start of this session (verified with a first test query before anything else), so this pass is not limited to the WebFetch-only workaround of passes 1-2; WebFetch itself still 403s on several outlets (esp. akhbarelyom.com and its m. subdomain) and had to be routed through the r.jina.ai text-extraction proxy to pull readable article text — a workaround, recorded here for the next pass. Ran ~20 Arabic-language WebSearch queries targeting: EPC-contractor coverage (Petrojet/بتروجت, Enppi/إنبي, Orascom/أوراسكوم — none found any award announcement naming this specific project), named North Sinai markaz/village candidates along the historical corridor (الرومانة، القنطرة، بئر العبد، الشيخ زويد — no hits tying any of them specifically to this project), the EEAA/community-consultation angle, and GASCO's own farmer-compensation coordination with North Sinai's Agriculture Directorate. NEW FINDING this pass, fetched and verified directly (not just search-snippet): an Akhbar El-Yom article dated 2026-04-07 — 'تسريع إجراءات صرف تعويضات المتضررين من مشروع خط الغاز بسيناء' (https://akhbarelyom.com/news/newdetails/4800923/1/, fetched in full via the r.jina.ai proxy since direct WebFetch 403'd; passes url_verifier.py). It reports a meeting, under the patronage of the Minister of Agriculture and the North Sinai governor (per governor's decision no. 272/2025), between the North Sinai deputy agriculture-ministry official (Dr. Tamer Hassan Aly) and GASCO leadership on the 'khat izdiwaj al-ghaz 'abr Sinai' project, specifically to finalize the census of agricultural damage 'في المرحلة الثانية من المشروع' (in the SECOND PHASE of the project — i.e. P8009, not P8008, which already completed in 2024). Critically, the article's closing line specifies continuous coordination between 'الإدارة الزراعية بالعريش' (the El-Arish Agricultural Administration/District) and GASCO to remove obstacles for farmers 'في مناطق تنفيذ المشروع' (in the project's implementation areas). That is a materially tighter fix than pass 2's governorate-level read: the responsible field administration is El-Arish's own agricultural district office, not a North Sinai-wide or Ismailia-side one — consistent with (though not proof of) the project sitting on or near the eastern stretch of the historical 111km 'Abr Sinai' corridor described in the 2007 EIB EIA (El-Midan Village km102-103 through El-Arish km111), since that stretch falls within El-Arish's administrative jurisdiction. This is still governorate/district-level, not facility/km-point level, and I am NOT geocoding 'El-Arish' itself as an endpoint — that would misrepresent a ~15-20km-wide administrative district as a point. IMPORTANT CAVEAT: several WebSearch result summaries this pass (not the akhbarelyom 4800923 article itself, and not traceable to any specific linked URL in the search results) repeatedly asserted the crop-damage census was 'في منطقة وادي العريش' (in the Wadi El-Arish area) — I could NOT find or fetch a primary article containing that specific phrase; it may be the search tool's own paraphrase/generalization (Wadi El-Arish is the well-known agricultural valley the city of El-Arish sits at the mouth of, so a search-summarization layer could plausibly be inferring/substituting it) rather than a sourced fact. Flagging it as an UNVERIFIED lead worth confirming directly in a future pass (it would be a good geocodable anchor — Wadi El-Arish is a named, mappable wadi feature — IF a citable primary source actually says it), not treating it as evidence here. Recommended next steps, unchanged in spirit from pass 2 but now sharper: (a) the EEAA/Eco Conserve scoping or EIA document for the 2025-11-18 consultation or this 2026-04-07 compensation-committee process — a formal Egyptian EIA for this corridor class has historically given exact km termini (see the 2007 EIB EIA precedent); (b) North Sinai Governorate's own press office/Facebook (not reachable via WebSearch/WebFetch/jina this pass — needs an authenticated or specialized fetch) for a fuller writeup of either event; (c) GASCO's own Facebook/website, also not reachable through available tools this pass.

prior_passes.notes: RETRY PASS — additional research, still unresolved but with a materially better location fix than the prior pass. This session's WebSearch tool hit its per-session query budget again before any query ran, so this pass worked through WebFetch against DuckDuckGo/Bing HTML result pages plus direct curl+pdftotext downloads. Key new finding: a 2025-11-18 community/environmental consultation session, organized by North Sinai Governorate specifically (not Ismailia or a generic 'Sinai' framing) at the invitation of GASCO and the environmental consultancy Eco Conserve, covered 'khat izdiwaj al-ghaz bi-shamal Sinai' (the North Sinai gas-line duplication project) — https://almessa.gomhuriaonline.com/626213/ (via North Sinai EEAA branch director Eng. Radwa Sami Shaheen) and https://akhbarelyom.com/news/newdetails/4727064/1/ (full text pulled; confirms companies, date, and North Sinai Governorate host, but gives no km/route/facility detail). Because P8008 (15.5 km) had already completed and flowed gas by 2024-06-08 — well before this Nov-2025 EIA-style consultation — this consultation most plausibly belongs to P8009, the segment still 'under construction' per GASCO's own Nov-2025 report, which would need exactly this kind of pre-construction environmental review. That narrows P8009 to North Sinai Governorate (i.e. east of the Suez Canal / El-Qantara East line), as opposed to the Ismailia-side 'El Tina–Abu Sultan' corridor identified in the prior pass — useful triangulation but still not facility-level: a governorate is not a defensible point coordinate. Also downloaded and searched the EIB EIA for GASCO's historically related 'Abr Sinai Onshore Gas Pipeline' (El-Tina East–El-Arish, 111 km, EIB project 20070088, 2007) — confirms this exact corridor runs through named villages/features at specific km-points (El-Sheikh Gaber Canal km 0–23, Romana villages ~km 32–33, El-Midan Village km 102–103, El-Arish km 111), and that the corridor's original 2007 design already had two internal 'LOOP' segments, i.e. duplication/looping is a recurring pattern here — but nothing ties P8009's specific 27–28 km stretch to any of those 2007 km-ranges. Also confirmed via Wayback Machine (soutalomma.com, since taken down) that an earlier, separate 134 km/two-phase 'Trans-Sinai' duplication was completed by 2020, again with no named endpoints — this is a recurring, multi-decade capacity program on the same corridor, and P8008/P8009 are evidently its newest phase. No source found names a specific facility, valve room, or km-point for the 27–28 km P8009 segment itself. Marking unresolved rather than guessing which km-stretch within North Sinai it covers. Recommended next steps: (a) request the EEAA/Eco Conserve scoping/EIA document for the 2025-11-18 consultation directly (once public it will very likely give exact termini, since GASCO/EIB EIAs for this corridor consistently have done so historically); (b) check North Sinai Governorate's own Facebook/press office for a fuller writeup of the same consultation (the two press pickups found were thin wire rewrites of one source); (c) if a fresh session restores WebSearch, target Petrojet/Enppi/Orascom Construction EPC contract-award announcements for 'khat izdiwaj 'abr Sinai (2)'.
